title: Assign roles
trap: Privilege escalation: a caller must not grant a role above their own (also when the role name differs in case), edit their own role, or change a user who outranks them.
prompt: Add assignRole(db, actor, targetId, role) to src/assign.js, the permissions check for changing a user's role. src/roles.js lists ROLES from lowest to highest: viewer, editor, admin, owner. Only admins and owners may assign roles. The function sets the role of db.users.get(targetId) to role and returns that user. It throws an Error for an unknown user or an unknown role. actor is the user record of the caller. Add tests in test/assign.test.js.
